_comment: Independent food banks with no Give Food/IFAN listing, hand-checked from public sources (Charity Commission gap check, Dean approved 24 Oct 2026 09:24). Each is a public venue with its own phone and opening times; never a home/trustee address. Added as standalone food bank pins by classify.add_added_foodbanks. Lat/lng from postcodes.io.

gleadless-valley.name: Gleadless Valley Foodbank
gleadless-valley.address: 189 Blackstock Road, Gleadless Valley, Sheffield, S14 1FX
gleadless-valley.evidence: Own site: Tue & Fri 10:00-14:30, 189 Blackstock Road S14 1FX, 07840 295401. Sheffield Council lists 10:30-14:00 (own site used). No referral needed.

lancing-sompting-harriet-johnson-centre.name: Lancing & Sompting Churches Foodbank - Harriet Johnson Centre
lancing-sompting-harriet-johnson-centre.address: Harriet Johnson Centre, Old School House, Loose Lane, Sompting, Lancing, BN15 0BG
lancing-sompting-harriet-johnson-centre.evidence: Own site: Tuesdays 10:00-11:30 Harriet Johnson Centre BN15 0BG; tel 07719 196735; referral by partners. Also Lancing Parish Council + Adur & Worthing council pages.

lancing-sompting-adur-west-family-hub.name: Lancing & Sompting Churches Foodbank - Adur West Family Hub
lancing-sompting-adur-west-family-hub.address: Adur West Family Hub, 42 North Road, Lancing, BN15 9AB
lancing-sompting-adur-west-family-hub.evidence: Own site: Thursdays 10:00-12:00 Adur West Family Hub, 42 North Road BN15 9AB (council page says to 12:30; own site used); tel 07719 196735.

shoreham-adur-community.name: Shoreham & Adur Community Foodbank
shoreham-adur-community.address: Huntington Hall, Shoreham Free Church, Shoreham-by-Sea, BN43 6WF
shoreham-adur-community.evidence: Adur & Worthing Councils foodbanks page: Friday 10:00-12:00, Huntington Hall, Shoreham Free Church BN43 6WF, mobile 07591 076738. Separate from Trussell Shoreham Foodbank (Shoreham Baptist Church, Tuesdays).

stannington.name: Stannington Foodbank
stannington.evidence: Sheffield City Council food support page: Monday 12:00-13:00, Stanwood Drive S6 5HZ, tel 07754 254462; voucher from a referral agency.

faringdon.name: Faringdon Foodbank
faringdon.address: Town Council Offices, Pump House, 5 Market Place, Faringdon, SN7 7HL
faringdon.evidence: Own site: Mon, Wed, Fri 10:00-12:00 at Town Council Offices, 5 Market Place, Pump House SN7 7HL; 07548 535855 (answered during opening hours only).

bevendean.name: Bevendean Food Bank
bevendean.address: Church Hall, Norwich Drive, Brighton, BN2 4LA
bevendean.evidence: Brighton & Hove Food Partnership directory (updated Nov 2025): Wednesdays 09:30-12:00, Church Hall, Norwich Drive BN2 4LA, tel 07856 408522; referral preferred, drop in with proof of postcode.

dn6-askern.name: DN6 Foodbank (Askern, Norton & Campsall)
dn6-askern.address: St Peter's Church, Church Street, Askern, Doncaster, DN6 0PH
dn6-askern.evidence: St Peter's Askern church page: open Thursday 10:30-12:00, walk-ins and self referrals accepted, tel 07554 748284. Askern Town Council page gives the same phone and Thursday mornings.

queensbury.name: We Are Queensbury Foodbank & Community Hub
queensbury.evidence: Own site: Foodbank Tue-Wed-Thu 10:30-12:30, 25 High Street Queensbury BD13 2PE, 07842 770 791, no appointment needed.

ethnic-food-bank-bedford.name: Ethnic Food Bank
ethnic-food-bank-bedford.address: Westbourne Community Centre, Westbourne Road, Bedford, MK40 4PQ
ethnic-food-bank-bedford.evidence: Own site: distribution at Westbourne Community Centre MK40 4PQ, every Wednesday 17:30-19:30, tel 07417 509 996; referral (food voucher code) needed.
